data.name: SKC每日覆盖推送与提前下架提醒
无库存测试款每日推送及提前下架提醒

parameters.sql:
SELECT
substr(date_str,1,7) month_str
,skc
,image_src 图片链接
,first_published_at 首次上架时间

,designer_name 设计师名
,business_group_name 业务部门
,decode(max(is_online_adjustment),1l,'在架',0l,'不在架') 当月是否在架
,sum(is_online_adjustment) 在架天数
,min(if(date_str between date_add(first_published_at,1) and date_add(first_published_at,4),is_online_adjustment,null )) =0 提前下架
,sum(sale_amount_usd) 销售额
,sum(sale_quantity) 销量
,sum(collection_click_user)/nullif(sum(collection_view_user),0) CTR
,SUM(sale_quantity)/nullif(sum(pdp_view_user),0) CVR
from cupshe_bigdata_ads.ads_prod_skc_product_info_di
WHERE 
    style_position = '无库存测试款'
    and pt >= 20251201
    and substr(first_published_at,1,7) = substr(date_sub(GETDATE(),-1),1,7)
    and nvl(channels,'独立站') = '独立站'
    -- and big_category = '成衣'
group by substr(date_str,1,7) 
,skc
,image_src
,first_published_at
,designer_name
,business_group_name
limit 1
